note: The wandering lights of the Feerrott. Its people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (West Feerrott), every one a wisp: Elder Faintglow, on the hill above the south pond, gives the first two; Watchlight Gleam, a little east of her by the pond, the three hunts; Lampwright Glimmer, up the hill to the north-west, is the outfitter; Coachman Wick keeps the stable on the rise to the south-west (his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes). The bog rats (the reeds to the east), the bog gnats (the pools to the south) and the young jaguar Duskpaw (north-west) are placed for these quests. A wisp speaks in few words, and of light. Levels 7-20 (2026-11-11): Watchlight Gleam gives L7-L15, Elder Faintglow the L20 path; their objectives are on the Homelands' shared ground, the Goldfeather Eyrie (Wick's coach): drift rat fur for Glimmer's lamps, Glimmer's oil and pale owl eyes, six frostpaw cubs, the Rimeheart's shard to Spiritmaster Oswin, then Scout Feyla's raiders and word to Warden Halvek.

L1.name: A Bead of Marsh Glass
offer: Oh! A new light, kindled out of the mist. Hush, little flame. Burn slowly. You are among your own.
A light with nothing to hold it drifts and thins. Each of us keeps a bead of marsh glass to gather in. Lampwright Glimmer blows them, a short drift up the hill to the north.
Will you fetch your bead and show it to me?
L1.declined: Then drift a while. The mist will keep you.
L1.started: Glimmer glows a short drift up the hill to the north.

piece.name: marsh-glass bead
piece.description: A bead of green marsh glass on a reed cord. A wisp's light gathers in it and does not thin.

fetch.journal: Ask Lampwright Glimmer, up the hill north of Elder Faintglow, for a marsh-glass bead.
fetch.says: A new light! Come close. Closer. There: the glass knows you now. It was sand and fire once, as you were mist. No price, little flame.

show.journal: Show the marsh-glass bead to Elder Faintglow.
show.says: See how it holds you. Keep it near, and you will not thin, however far the wind carries you.

L2.name: A Light That Returns
offer: Lights go out, little flame. It is not the end, if you are tied to a place. Have Spiritmaster Shimmer tie you to the swamp, so that you kindle here again.
Then give your name to Coachman Wick for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
L2.declined: Then burn low until you do.
L2.started: Shimmer glows on the hill to the north. Wick waits on the rise to the south-west.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Shimmer, on the hill north of the elder, bind your spirit to the swamp.
bind.says: It is done. Go out where you will, and you will kindle here again among us. Now give Coachman Wick your name.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Wick, on the rise south-west of the elder, for his ledger.
ledger.says: A passenger who weighs nothing! My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for those whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

says: Good. Now the dark cannot keep you.
Wick's coach goes where its ledgers know you, but a shape to walk in Qeynos is earned. Watchlight Gleam, by the pond to the east, has work for you.

L3.name: Rats in the Reeds
offer: The new light. Good. Bog rats gnaw the reeds east of here, where our youngest glow, and a rat will snap at anything bright.
Put out a few, and bring me three of their tails. Then I will show you something a light should know.
Will you hunt them?
L3.declined: Then the reeds grow thinner, and so do we.
L3.started: Three tails. East, in the reeds.

drop.name: bog rat tail
drop.description: The tail of a bog rat from the reeds of the West Feerrott.

hunt.journal: Take three bog rat tails from the bog rats in the reeds east of the elder.

give.journal: Bring three bog rat tails to Watchlight Gleam.
give.says: Three tails, and you burn as bright as before. Good. Now be still, and learn this.

L4.name: A Shape to Hold
offer: A bare light can carry nothing. I will make you something to bear, but you must bring what goes into it.
Lampwright Glimmer keeps leather and cord for me. Then take a wing from the bog gnats that cloud the pools to the south.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then go bare, and carry only yourself.
L4.started: Leather and cord from Glimmer, a wing from the gnats. Go.

materials.journal: Ask Lampwright Glimmer for the leather strip and the silk cord.
materials.says: For Gleam? Here. Leather, and a cord of silk. Heavy things. I do not know how the walking folk bear them.

drop.name: bog gnat wing
drop.description: A wing, thin as breath, from the gnats over the south pools of the West Feerrott.

hunt.journal: Take a bog gnat wing from the bog gnats over the pools south of the elder.

give.journal: Bring the leather strip, the silk cord and the bog gnat wing to Watchlight Gleam.
give.says: All three. A moment, while I bind them... there. It is yours. Let it be your hands.

L5.name: Duskpaw
offer: One thing more. A young jaguar, Duskpaw, has learned that lights can be caught. It dens to the north-west, and two of ours have gone dark there.
It will spring as soon as it sees your glow. Do not flee. Put it out, and bring me its fang.
Will you hunt Duskpaw?
L5.declined: It hunts tonight, whether you do or not.
L5.started: North-west, beyond Glimmer's hill. It will see you first.

drop.name: Duskpaw's fang
drop.description: A fang of the young jaguar Duskpaw, who hunted the lights of the West Feerrott.

hunt.journal: Take Duskpaw's fang from the young jaguar Duskpaw, north-west of the elder.

give.journal: Bring Duskpaw's fang to Watchlight Gleam.
says: Duskpaw's fang! The youngest may glow in peace. You are no small flame now.
Learn this, and find Gatekeeper Dimlight to the south-east when you are ready for Qeynos.

flight.name: A Shape for Qeynos
offer: In Qeynos the humans will take you for one of their own, so long as your armour holds its shape around you. They train any who come in good faith.
You have earned the way, bright one. I will set you down among your own guild there, and your light will rest in Qeynos.
Shall I send you to Qeynos?
flight.declined: The swamp will hold your light a while longer.
flight.started: Burn bright, and keep your helm on!
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Dimlight when you are ready to go to Qeynos.

L7.name: White Fur for the Lamps
offer: You burn steadier now. Good. The Homelands keep an outpost on the frozen river under the Goldfeather Eyrie, and every home sends its young there.
The drift rats on the snow east of it wear a white fur that holds a glow. Glimmer packs her lamps with it. Ride Wick's coach there, and bring me three clumps.
Will you go out into the cold for us?
L7.declined: The cold is patient. So are we.
L7.started: Burn close to the others there. The snow eats small lights.

drop.name: drift rat fur
drop.description: A clump of white fur from a drift rat of the Goldfeather Eyrie's snow.

hunt.journal: Take three clumps of drift rat fur from the drift rats on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the three clumps of drift rat fur to Watchlight Gleam.
give.says: Three clumps, and still warm. Glimmer's lamps will glow through the long nights. Be still now, and learn this.

L10.name: An Eye for the Dark
offer: The pale owls of the Eyrie see by night, and they hunt our wandering lights. Their eyes are what lets them.
Lampwright Glimmer has oil set aside for me. Then bring me two eyes of the pale owls north of the Eyrie outpost, and I will shape you something better to hold.
Will you bring me the oil and the eyes?
L10.declined: Then hold what you have, and hold it tight.
L10.started: Oil from Glimmer, eyes from the owls. Do not let them see you first.

materials.journal: Ask Lampwright Glimmer for the lantern oil Gleam set aside.
materials.says: Gleam's oil. Here. It burns clean and slow, as a light should. Do not spill it on yourself.

drop.name: pale owl eye
drop.description: The wide, pale eye of an owl of the Goldfeather Eyrie, that sees by night.

hunt.journal: Take two pale owl eyes from the pale owls north of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the lantern oil and the two pale owl eyes to Watchlight Gleam.
give.says: Oil to burn, eyes to see. A moment, while I bind them... there. It is yours. It will not fail you in the dark.

L13.name: Cubs That Chase Lights
offer: Word came on Wick's coach. The frostpaw cubs north of the Eyrie outpost have learned to chase lights, the way Duskpaw did. Two of ours have gone dark in the snow.
They are only cubs. They will not stay cubs. Put out six of them before they learn more.
Will you hunt the frostpaw cubs?
L13.declined: Then they grow, and they learn.
L13.started: Six. Then come back, and burn bright.

hunt.journal: Kill six frostpaw cubs on the snow north of the Eyrie outpost.

back.says: Six. The snow is safer for small lights now. You are not small. Learn this.

L15.name: The Cold That Puts Out Lights
offer: There is a cold in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost that puts out any light that drifts too near. The hunters call it the Rimeheart.
Break it. Take a shard to Spiritmaster Oswin at the outpost: he keeps the spirits of every home, and he will know what to do with it. Then come back.
Will you face the Rimeheart?
L15.declined: Then keep away from the caves. Far away.
L15.started: Do not go alone. A light alone in that cold goes out.

drop.name: shard of the Rimeheart
drop.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

hunt.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

carry.journal: Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Spiritmaster Oswin at the Eyrie outpost.
carry.says: So cold, even now. I will keep it far from the bound spirits. Tell Gleam the lights of the Feerrott may drift here safely.

back.says: You came back, and you burn as bright as ever. Brighter. Learn this.

L20.name: The Long Light
offer: Gleam says you burn steady now, little flame. Not so little. Each of us, once, carries our light where the dark is thickest, so the other homes see it.
Go to Scout Feyla, who watches the Goldfeather eyrie from the frozen river. Do what she asks. Then come home, and choose your path.
Will you carry the long light?
L20.started: Go. We will keep a place for you.

road.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: A wisp? I saw you coming a long way off. Good: so will the raiders. Draw them out, and bring me two of their war-talons.

drop.name: Goldfeather war-talon
drop.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

hunt.journal: Take two war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.

handin.journal: Bring the two war-talons to Scout Feyla.
handin.says: Two talons. They will think twice about lights on the river now. Tell Warden Halvek it was done.

after.journal: Tell Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost that the raiders were drawn out.
after.says: Feyla's word, and yours. The outpost will remember the light from the Feerrott. Go home now.

final.journal: Return to Elder Faintglow in the West Feerrott.
final.says: You went out into the dark and came back brighter. That is all a light can do. The swamp has one more thing for you.
